HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP MARCH — TERMLY EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya.
   B. Explain Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya as rumours only.
   D. Say Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya never happens in Kenya.

2. Which statement about Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   C. Say Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya as rumours only.

3. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)

   A. Skip evidence when discussing African Civilisations.
